requirement: The system shall suppress sending an email to a recipient who has unsubscribed from the relevant notification category.
The system shall render an email by merging recipient-specific values into the template, and reject the send if any required placeholder is missing.
The marketing user composes a campaign and clicks send; the system queues one message per recipient, deduplicates by email address and reports the total queued.
The system shall retry failed email deliveries with exponential backoff up to a maximum of five attempts before marking them permanently failed.
As a user, I want to view my in-app notification feed so that I can catch up on alerts I may have missed.
As a support agent, I want to send a manual notification to a customer so that I can follow up on a query outside the normal automated templates.
No customer email address may be exposed to other recipients in the To or Cc fields; bulk sends must use individual messages.
Every outbound notification must be logged with recipient, template, channel, provider response and timestamp for troubleshooting and compliance.
The notification log table shall ensure that recipient and template are always present and that channel is one of the recognised values.
code:
-- notification delivery log
CREATE TABLE notification_log (
    log_id            BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    recipient         VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL,
    template_id       VARCHAR(60)  NOT NULL,
    channel           VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    provider_response VARCHAR(500),
    occurred_at       TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT log_recipient_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(recipient)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT log_template_not_blank  CHECK (length(trim(template_id)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT log_channel_chk         CHECK (channel IN ('EMAIL','SMS','PUSH','IN_APP','WEBHOOK'))
);

CREATE INDEX log_recipient_idx ON notification_log (recipient, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX log_channel_idx ON notification_log (channel, occurred_at DESC);

-- email template table
CREATE TABLE email_template (
    template_id   VARCHAR(60) PRIMARY KEY,
    name          VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    subject       VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    body          TEXT NOT NULL,
    category      VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT template_category_chk CHECK (category IN ('TRANSACTIONAL','MARKETING','SYSTEM'))
);
-- unsubscribe preferences table
CREATE TABLE preferences (
    preference_id  BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    email          VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL,
    category       VARCHAR(40)  NOT NULL,
    opted_out      BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    updated_at     TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT preferences_unique UNIQUE (email, category)
);

requirement: Only authenticated administrative users may access the outbound queue and delivery logs; ordinary users must be refused.
The bounce processing job shall, for each hard-bounced address received from the provider, mark the address as undeliverable and remove it from active marketing lists.
